flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/examples/waitlist then Open the page.
Type "tester@publock.dev" into the email input.
Click the "Sign up" button.
Confirm a success message containing "You're on the list" appears on the page.

remark: click: Clicking the Sign up button below the email input
wait: PRIMARY: wait 1000 ms for the waitlist submission result to appear
press_key: PRIMARY: press the Enter key

summary:
After submitting the form, the automation expected the page to switch into a success state. When that did not happen within its short wait, it had no solid follow-up path and stopped without proving whether the app succeeded or failed.
Improve the post-submit check: wait explicitly for the text "You're on the list", allow a longer timeout, and if the page stays unchanged, fail with a clear assertion and capture network or console evidence.
one_liner: The form was filled and submitted, but the automation never reached a verifiable success state and ended stuck on the unchanged page.
reason: AP determined agent is stuck — no viable actions remain

verdict.root_cause: After submitting the form, the automation expected the page to switch into a success state. When that did not happen within its short wait, it had no solid follow-up path and stopped without proving whether the app succeeded or failed.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent does not appear to have clicked or typed the wrong control—the email field and the Sign up button were used as intended. But the run failure was still caused by the automation: it only waited 1000 ms, made an unnecessary Enter retry, and then terminated as stuck instead of collecting clearer evidence or cleanly asserting that the success message was missing.
verdict.bug_title: Automation gets stuck after waitlist submit
verdict.suggestion: Improve the post-submit check: wait explicitly for the text "You're on the list", allow a longer timeout, and if the page stays unchanged, fail with a clear assertion and capture network or console evidence.
